spans.s: 1. लुक् (only लुकिष्यसि and लुकित), prob. invented to explain the following word.

2. लुक् (prob. fr. √ लुञ्च्), and gram. term to express ‘the dropping out’ or ‘disappearance’ of Pratyayas or affixes (the symbols लुक्, लुप्, and श्लु are distinguished from लोप, q.v., and are called लुमत्, as containing the syllable लु).
